statement: Shopify's Series A is priced at a $30mm pre-money valuation, and the company has raised $3mm of funding prior to this round.
Shopify maintains regional offices in London and Berlin to support its European operations.
Customers have grown 81% year-over-year from 5,500 to nearly 10,000, and annualized gross merchandise value across the platform is approximately $132mm.
Shopify has signed up large businesses including Pixar, Amnesty International, and Nike at higher price points.
Shopify was founded in 2007 by two Ruby on Rails core developers.
The business is profitable, has 24 employees in Ottawa, and roughly two-thirds of customers use at least one app from the App Store.
With limited marketing, customers have grown from 5,500 a year ago to nearly 10,000 today.
Monthly logo churn stabilises at 3–5% after an initial drop-off, with roughly 50–60% of customers retained at month 12.
Customers grew 81% year-over-year, from 5,500 to nearly 10,000, while monthly recurring revenue grew 151%, from USD 164,000 to USD 438,000.
Paid acquisition costs are USD 175–225 per customer with a 7–9 month payback on a churn-adjusted basis.
Shopify continues to deliver against the thesis we underwrote at Series A.
The company has also opened a satellite office in Berlin to support European customer growth.
The company sells SaaS-based e-commerce software to SMBs and at-home merchants, with a typical customer signing up by credit card and going live within hours.
Annualised gross merchandise value transacted across the platform is approximately USD 132 million, which would place Shopify in the top 30 online retailers by GMV.
The business is profitable and has been largely bootstrapped, having raised USD 1 million prior to our investment.
Shopify has begun expanding into brick-and-mortar retail with an iPad-based point-of-sale offering and plans to introduce recurring billing for digital goods within the next year.
The App Store, launched a year ago, now hosts over 100 third-party applications, and roughly two-thirds of customers use at least one app.
Customer acquisition remains heavily organic, with 65–70% of customers arriving via word of mouth and a further 20% via web design firm referrals.
The team has recruited strongly in Ottawa at 60–70% of Bay Area or New York comparable cost.
Competitive positioning remains differentiated against Volusion, BigCommerce, and Magento, with Shopify's open API and ease of customisation cited consistently in customer diligence.
